name: vouch
//engines: 22.18.0, not 22.0: src imports .ts files directly, which needs Node type stripping, on by default from 22.18. Reasoned from documented behaviour, not tested on 22 (only Node 26 was available).

scripts.//build: Two origins means two deployments. `build` makes both; `build:site` and `build:peer` make one each, into separate output directories, so a deploy target can be pointed at either without the other coming with it.
scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:peer
scripts.//conformance: The community conformance CLI. Takes a published network's URL, not a site root, and not ours: `npm run conformance -- https://example.com/agents/my_network`. Its own tests run under the root vitest, so `npm test` covers it.

description: A deli website whose agents describe food but never decide whether it is safe to eat, and an open-agentic-web conformance checker anyone can run.
